description: Defines an interface for configuring transaction committers within the Orleans Transactions abstractions, specifying service and storage names.

classes.name: ITransactionCommitterConfiguration
classes.description: Interface specifying configuration properties for transaction committers, including service name and storage name.

methods.name: ServiceName
methods.description: Property to get the name of the service involved in transaction committing.

methods.name: StorageName
methods.description: Property to get the name of the storage used for transaction committing.
